name: AboutListTile
description: A convenience ListTile that opens an About dialog when tapped. It’s a quick way to include an app information section inside a Drawer or Settings screen.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Leading widget shown before the title (usually an Icon).

properties.name: child
properties.description: Custom widget for the tile’s title. If null, `applicationName` or a default text is used.

properties.name: applicationName
properties.description: The name of the application displayed in the About dialog.
properties.default_value: null (defaults to the MaterialApp title if available)

properties.name: applicationVersion
properties.description: The version of the application displayed in the About dialog.

properties.name: applicationIcon
properties.description: Widget displayed as the application icon inside the About dialog.

properties.name: applicationLegalese
properties.description: Optional legal text such as copyright or license info.

properties.name: aboutBoxChildren
properties.description: Additional widgets to display in the About dialog below the version/legalese.

properties.name: dense
properties.description: Whether this list tile is part of a vertically dense list.

properties.name: onTap
properties.description: Callback when the tile is tapped. Defaults to showing the About dialog.
